name: Heating element
summary: A heating element converts electrical energy to heat in a documented circuit.
description: A heating element converts electrical energy to heat in a documented circuit. Its supply, power rating and control/protection path need to be identified for cabinet or auxiliary-system use.
readingNotes: Trace the thermostat or control device separately from the element.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A heater is a load; its thermostat is a separate switching or measurement function.
